paper_title: Benchmark-Driven Selection of AI: Evidence from DeepSeek-R1
reason: 이 논문은 새로운 재사용 가능 벤치마크를 제안하지 않는다. 저자들이 HLE(Humanity's Last Exam) 공개분에 기여한 단일 순차적 의사결정 과제(Figure 1)를 DeepSeek-R1-0528, DS-R1, Phi-4-r+ 세 모델에 대해 64회 반복 샘플링으로 평가한 사례 연구로, 'benchmark-driven selection of AI'라는 현상을 논증하는 것이 목적이다. 새로운 데이터셋·태스크 모음·평가 하니스·공개 리소스를 도입하지 않으며, HLE 자체는 이미 인벤토리에 존재하는 벤치마크로 실질적 갱신도 없다. 따라서 재사용 가능 벤치마크 도입/갱신 기준에 해당하지 않아 제외한다.

screening.paper_title: Benchmark-Driven Selection of AI: Evidence from DeepSeek-R1
screening.abstract: Evaluation of reasoning language models gained importance after it was observed that they can combine their existing capabilities into novel traces of intermediate steps before task completion and that the traces can sometimes help them to generalize better than past models. As reasoning becomes the next scaling dimension of large language models, careful study of their capabilities in critical tasks is needed. We show that better performance is not always caused by test-time algorithmic improvements or model sizes but also by using impactful benchmarks as curricula for learning. We call this benchmark-driven selection of AI and show its effects on DeepSeek-R1 using our sequential decision-making problem from Humanity's Last Exam. Steering development of AI by impactful benchmarks trades evaluation for learning and makes novelty of test tasks key for measuring generalization capabilities of reasoning models. Consequently, some benchmarks could be seen as curricula for training rather than unseen test sets.
